Bhuvneshwar Kumar addresses Team India comeback prospects

Indian pace bowler Bhuvneshwar Kumar stated he is no longer focused on returning to the national team, emphasizing his priority is enjoying the game. He mentioned that his dream of playing for India has already been fulfilled. While he would be happy to get another opportunity, he is content with his current focus on playing cricket. Kumar made these statements in response to questions about his potential comeback to the Indian team.
